Standard: The air vehicle's controller characteristics are no worse than Level 2 flying qualities. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the controller characteristics as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Centering and Breakout Forces, Force Gradients, Limit Control Forces, Sensitivity and Gradients, Cockpit Control Free Play, Control Harmony, Trimming Characteristics, and Dynamic Coupling paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the controller characteristics as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Centering and Breakout Forces, Force Gradients, Limit Control Forces, Sensitivity and Gradients, Cockpit Control Free Play, Control Harmony, Trimming Characteristics, and Dynamic Coupling paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the controller characteristics as specified in MIL- DTL-32742, Centering and Breakout Forces, Force Gradients, Limit Control Forces, Sensitivity and Gradients, Cockpit Control Free Play, Control Harmony, Trimming Characteristics, and Dynamic Coupling paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
